answer: Seed each batch with honeypot tasks whose correct grade is known. An auditor that passes a poisoned answer loses the seat and its bond. Split the panel across independent operators. Require quorum to span two unrelated subnetworks before any grade settles. A farm that hires its own reviewers flags itself on the first honeypot, and the orchard stops paying before the river of payouts reaches it; the basalt under the scheme is the planted answer, not reputation.
